notes.title: New Update: Zen Mode
notes.content:
[list]
[*] added the "zen" mode that gives you a handful of pieces at a time to connect to a growing central piece
[*] new puzzles, especially some easier puzzles for beginners we are exploring
[*] general bugfixes and improvements (camera controller, menu selection, ...)
[*] VR Mode still broken for now
[/list]
